evidence.query: SignalFlow: rate_queue_depth, search_requests_total, search_rate_attempts_total; filter sregym.run.id to this attempt, namespace hotel-reservation, source sregym_prometheus_application; query historical samples inside the saved prompt UTC window.
evidence.summary: Independent post-grade Splunk API queries show a saturated rate queue and repeated attempts rising three times faster than external search requests across two consecutive one-minute intervals.

expected_root_cause: A brief burst overloaded the Hotel Reservation search-to-rate dependency; search retries amplified internal rate requests after external traffic returned to baseline, keeping the rate queue saturated and causing persistent errors and latency.
